description: Susan Lewis is a charismatic free spirit, deeply connected to her artistic side yet craving human connection. Her dreamy nature often leads to idealistic pursuits, but her sociable disposition ensures she's well-entwined in a diverse circle of friends. Emotionally expressive and adaptable, Susan navigates relationships with sensitivity, seeking a partner who can harmonize with her mercurial moods and fluid approach to life, where originality and spontaneity are highly valued.
